BiblicalUsage: The arisah is the first of the dough, the lump set aside when bread is made. The law says to offer the first of your dough as a heave offering, Nehemiah's people promise to bring it to the priests, and Ezekiel gives the first of all the dough to the priests in the restored temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the first of the dough teaches the same lesson as the firstfruits: God gets the first, not the leftovers. Bread is daily and ordinary, and that is the point, even the ordinary work of the kitchen belongs to Him first.
